Welcome to a journey where intelligence isn’t just a human trait—it’s something we share with the entire animal kingdom. Have you ever watched an animal and wondered what’s really going on in its mind? Together, we’ll dive into the world inspired by Frans de Waal’s thought-provoking book, Are We Smart Enough to Know How Smart Animals Are?
Here, we’ll explore how intelligence can appear in the most unexpected places, hidden in the daily lives of creatures all around us. What if the line between instinct and intellect isn’t as clear as we once thought? As we look closer, we’ll see primates solving puzzles, elephants comforting friends, birds planning ahead, and even octopuses showing off their cleverness. Each animal becomes a main character in this unfolding story, offering us glimpses of empathy, social skills, and problem-solving that might just rival our own. Along the way, we’ll discover that understanding animal intelligence isn’t just about them—it’s also about us. It’s about opening our minds, letting go of old assumptions, and seeing the world with a sense of humility and wonder. So, let’s set out together, ready to challenge what we think we know, and open the door to a bigger, richer understanding of what it really means to be smart.
